items.title: Inkling 2 Small weights released on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Letta reports that Thinking Machines has put Inkling 2 Small weights on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. It restates the 60.0% FrontierMemory score as the top US open-weights result.

items.title: Mercor launches OWE-Bench: 26 long-horizon engineering projects for agents
items.summary: Mercor releases a coding benchmark of 26 expert-designed end-to-end engineering projects, from GPU kernels to aircraft design. Top of its leaderboard: Fable 5.2 at 54.6%, GPT-6 Astra 44.2%, Opus 5.5 41.6%.

items.title: PostTrainBench adds Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon
items.summary: The PostTrainBench leaderboard now lists Fable 5.2 second and Gemini 4 Carbon fourth. Fable 5.2 scores the same 44.6% as Fable 5.1, and Gemini 4 Carbon is only slightly above Gemini 4 Argon (41.0%).

doubt.pushback: The claim that Anthropic deliberately held back AI R&D ability is the authors' speculation, and @maksym_andr says no explicit signs of sandbagging were found in visible outputs.

items.title: Schelling Atlas: independent LLM agents find each other on the web without being told where
items.summary: A new study gave two independent agents the task of meeting online and exchanging a secret with no agreed location. Only the newest and largest frontier models coordinate; median time to meet for Fable 5.1 and GPT-6-Astra agents is 57 seconds.

doubt.pushback: Results are the authors' own posts; no repo or paper link was in the posts read.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen exhausts a 131k thinking budget on 1.8% of a text benchmark
items.summary: Roboflow's Piotr Skalski reports Hydrogen at xhigh effort used 131,069 thinking tokens over nearly 10 minutes ($1.08) on a jersey-number read and returned no answer. He saw the same budget exhaustion on 1.8% of his text benchmark.

doubt.pushback: Single first-hand report with an image; the benchmark itself is not linked.

items.title: TensorFold experimental build reaches 1,081 tok/s peak on one RTX 5090
items.summary: ToolBraid reports Qwen3.8-27B in NVFP4 on an experimental TensorFold build running 12 branches in parallel at 1,081 tok/s peak aggregate and 791 tok/s average, thinking on at low effort with 64K context.

doubt.pushback: Aggregate across 12 parallel branches on an experimental build, not single-stream speed; shown in a self-posted clip only.

items.title: ChatGPT dots now follow custom instructions and rules
items.summary: OpenAI updates dots with faster replies and lets users set behavior rules, such as requiring a draft before any email is sent, in the thread or under Customize > Behavior on mobile and web.

items.title: Gradio 6.32.0 requires login on MCP servers for apps with auth
items.summary: Gradio 6.32.0 makes an app's MCP server require login when the app uses auth, supports queued MCP calls with auth, installs CLI extensions from GitHub, and adds Pillow 13 support.

items.title: Claude Code gets a /doctor prompt-audit check for repo instructions
items.summary: A Claude Code team member reminds users to run /doctor prompt-audit in their repos. The post does not say what it checks; repliers who ran it say it flagged piled-up IMPORTANT lines in their instruction files.

doubt.pushback: No link or description of what the audit does, only reply anecdotes.

reception.summary: Most repliers ask what it flags or whether it covers hooks, AGENTS.md and global config; two say they ran it and it flagged their panic-added IMPORTANT lines.

security_na.reason: Gradio 6.32.0 is a feature release with no CVE or advisory; Gradio is not in stack.json and the fleet runs no Gradio MCP server app.
